svg.title: StrataMoE actionability outcome by modeled GPU capacity and seed
svg.desc: A 5 by 30 matrix shows modeled link-byte change versus no action for every preregistered abrupt-shift seed. Savings occur at 8 and 64 slots, regressions occur at 32 slots, and the intervention takes no action at 16 and 96 slots. The candidate failed its carry-forward gates.
svg.text: first 64 post-shift tokens / modeled link bytes / lower is better
